title: The Land of Sand Without Water

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Pouring sand through their fingers, a child wonders whether there might be a land made only of sand, with no water at all.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Pouring sand through their fingers, (name1), a child, wonders whether there might be a land made only of sand, with no water at all.

choices.label: Ask How Isolans Would Survive There.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A scholar wonders how anyone could live there, and an elder suggests they might know secrets of water Isolans never needed.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A storyteller imagines golden hills of sand stretching forever.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village decides they would learn from the people who already live there.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A fisher says they would simply stay home, thank you.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The child imagines people walking for days to find water, and feels grateful for the stream.
